text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services recommends stop control for the minor street at the uncontrolled three-way intersection of Cranston Manor Court and Senator Boulevard in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Cranston Manor Court at Senator Boulevard.
